visualCharacteristics: Light background, two-column split layout. Left column holds a large heading, a subheading paragraph and two CTA buttons. Right column holds a cluster of three showcase images (one wide image on top, two below).
contentPattern: Heading + subheading + CTA button group in the first cell; a set of showcase images in a second cell.
usage: Prominent page introduction / intro banner combining messaging, calls to action and lifestyle imagery.
